title: Energizing Velvety Canadian Matcha Nimono
description: A salty and velvety Canadian dish featuring matcha and nimono simmer, perfect for a cold winter day. This nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to energize and satisfy.
instructions: In a large pot, combine dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sake, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium low and add the chicken breast to the pot.
Simmer the chicken for 10 minutes or until it is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside to rest.
In a small bowl, whisk together the matcha powder and a splash of the hot broth until smooth.
Add the matcha mixture back into the pot and stir to combine.
Add the sliced green onions to the pot and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Slice the rested chicken into thin strips and add it back to the pot.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the top of the dish and serve hot.
